note: Plain-language descriptions of every CSV column, of the fields the site builder derives for the JSON API, and of the site summary objects. Locators are not footprints; statuses are the last observed physical status on the status date, not a current status; empty values mean unknown, never zero.

sites.csv.site_id: Atlas identifier of the physical site (vcc-site-…), derived deterministically from physical_site_stable_key. Primary key.
sites.csv.physical_site_stable_key: Stable curation key of the physical site or parent campus, for example curated:<slug>. It groups the projects at one site; it is not a claim of global de-duplication across other databases.
sites.csv.name: Site or campus name as given by the selected source evidence. Not a legal entity name.
sites.csv.country: Name of the country or territory where the site is located.
sites.csv.country_iso_a2: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the country or territory.
sites.csv.latitude: WGS 84 latitude, in decimal degrees, of the site's display anchor. For a Point it repeats the point locator, with the same scope and precision limits (some point locators are themselves source-derived centroids). For a Polygon or MultiPolygon it is only a convenient marker position for the shape, usually but not always inside it, and not a surveyed point; geometry_json is the locator. Never use it as a building or construction location.
sites.csv.longitude: WGS 84 longitude, in decimal degrees, of the site's display anchor (see latitude).
sites.csv.geometry_json: GeoJSON geometry (WGS 84, longitude then latitude) of the site's reviewed locator or official boundary: a Point, Polygon or MultiPolygon. A locator only locates the site; it is not a building footprint, construction extent or surveyed boundary. Even an official boundary is a parcel or permit boundary, not the area under construction.
sites.csv.geometry_type: GeoJSON type of geometry_json: Point, Polygon or MultiPolygon.
sites.csv.geometry_source_entity_kinds_json: JSON array of what the source geometries describe (campus, facility, building, project or address_area), one entry per distinct value across the site's projects.
sites.csv.geometry_derivations_json: JSON array of how the published geometry was derived from its source, for example direct_geometry or coordinates_to_point. Free-form review codes, shown verbatim.
sites.csv.geometry_methods_json: JSON array of the source-specific methods used to obtain the geometry. Free-form review codes, shown verbatim.
sites.csv.geometry_scope_classes_json: JSON array of scope classes saying what the geometry represents, for example a shared-campus reference point or an official address locator. Free-form review codes, shown verbatim.
sites.csv.geometry_authority_classes_json: JSON array of the authority of the geometry sources: official_source, community_source or community_mapped.
sites.csv.geometry_use_scopes_json: JSON array of how the geometry may be used: official_boundary, campus_locator, project_locator or reviewed_site_locator. Every scope except official_boundary is a locator, not a footprint.
sites.csv.geometry_precision_scopes_json: JSON array of plain-language statements of what the geometry does and does not represent.
sites.csv.horizontal_uncertainty_metres: Stated horizontal uncertainty of the locator in metres, when a bounded value is known. Empty means unknown, never zero.
sites.csv.horizontal_uncertainty_unknown_reason: Why no numeric horizontal uncertainty is given. Empty when horizontal_uncertainty_metres is set.
sites.csv.geometry_evidence_ids_json: JSON array of evidence_id values (evidence.csv) of the sources that supplied the site geometry.
sites.csv.project_count: Number of selected construction projects linked to the site in this checkpoint.
sites.csv.project_ids_json: JSON array of the project_id values (projects.csv) linked to the site.
sites.csv.project_stable_keys_json: JSON array of the stable curation keys of the projects linked to the site.
sites.csv.statuses_json: JSON array of the distinct last observed physical statuses of the site's projects. Each is the status reported on that project's status date, not a current status.
sites.csv.oldest_status_as_of: Earliest status date (status_as_of) among the site's projects, as an ISO 8601 date.
sites.csv.newest_status_as_of: Latest status date (status_as_of) among the site's projects, as an ISO 8601 date.
sites.csv.verification_posture: Code summarising the verification basis: a recent authoritative physical-status observation plus either a reviewed locator or an official boundary. It does not mean independent, imagery-based or on-site verification.
sites.csv.independent_imagery_verification: Whether construction has been independently verified from imagery. The schema allows only false: no checkpoint claims independent imagery verification.
sites.csv.imagery_review_outcomes_json: JSON array of the imagery review outcome codes of the site's projects, for example not_reviewed_for_core_preview. Outcomes are review records only and never create or change a construction claim.

projects.csv.project_id: Atlas identifier (UUID) of the construction project, stable across checkpoints for the same project. Primary key.
projects.csv.project_stable_key: Stable curation key of the project: the parent site key plus a project or phase slug.
projects.csv.site_id: Physical site the project belongs to (sites.csv site_id).
projects.csv.physical_site_stable_key: Stable curation key of the project's physical site or parent campus.
projects.csv.name: Project or phase name as curated from the selected source evidence.
projects.csv.country: Name of the country or territory where the project is located.
projects.csv.country_iso_a2: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the country or territory.
projects.csv.latitude: WGS 84 latitude, in decimal degrees, of the display anchor of the project's locator. Often the parent campus locator; not the position of the construction works.
projects.csv.longitude: WGS 84 longitude, in decimal degrees, of the display anchor of the project's locator (see latitude).
projects.csv.geometry_json: GeoJSON geometry (WGS 84, longitude then latitude) used to locate the project. It is often the parent campus locator and is not a project footprint unless geometry_use_scope and geometry_precision_scope say so.
projects.csv.geometry_type: GeoJSON type of geometry_json: Point, Polygon or MultiPolygon.
projects.csv.geometry_source_entity_kind: What the source geometry describes: campus, facility, building, project or address_area. A campus geometry used for a project locates the campus, not the project.
projects.csv.geometry_derivation: How the published geometry was derived from the source geometry, for example direct_geometry or coordinates_to_point. Free-form review code, shown verbatim.
projects.csv.geometry_method: Source-specific method used to obtain the geometry. Free-form review code, shown verbatim.
projects.csv.geometry_scope_class: What the geometry represents, for example an official address locator point or a shared-campus reference point. Free-form review code, shown verbatim.
projects.csv.geometry_authority_class: Authority of the geometry source: official_source (a government or first-party publisher), community_source or community_mapped (for example OpenStreetMap). Community geometry is never an official boundary.
projects.csv.geometry_use_scope: Permitted use of the geometry: official_boundary (an official parcel or surveyed boundary), campus_locator, project_locator or reviewed_site_locator. Locators are not footprints.
projects.csv.geometry_precision_scope: Plain-language statement of what the geometry does and does not represent.
projects.csv.horizontal_uncertainty_metres: Stated horizontal uncertainty of the locator in metres, when a bounded value is known. Empty means unknown, never zero.
projects.csv.horizontal_uncertainty_unknown_reason: Why no numeric horizontal uncertainty is given. Empty when horizontal_uncertainty_metres is set.
projects.csv.geometry_evidence_id: evidence_id (evidence.csv) of the primary geometry source.
projects.csv.last_observed_physical_status: Physical construction status reported by the selected authoritative source on status_as_of, for example under_construction or shell. It is the last observed status, not a current status: work may have progressed, paused or finished since.
projects.csv.status_as_of: Date (ISO 8601) on which the status was observed or reported. Selection requires it to fall within the status window, at most 90 days before the checkpoint's fixed lifecycle reference date.
projects.csv.status_age_days_at_review: Number of days from status_as_of to the checkpoint's fixed lifecycle reference date.
projects.csv.status_method: How the status was established, for example authoritative_physical_status_update (a dated authoritative report of physical work) or authoritative_construction_start (a dated authoritative report that construction started).
projects.csv.status_evidence_id: evidence_id (evidence.csv) of the source that reports the status.
projects.csv.verification_posture: Code summarising the verification basis of the project: a recent authoritative physical-status observation plus a reviewed locator or an official boundary. It does not mean independent, imagery-based or on-site verification.
projects.csv.independent_imagery_verification: Whether construction has been independently verified from imagery. The schema allows only false: no checkpoint claims independent imagery verification.
projects.csv.imagery_review_outcome: Imagery review outcome code, for example not_reviewed_for_core_preview. Review outcomes are records only and never create or change a lifecycle claim.
projects.csv.development_type: Development type (greenfield, expansion or retrofit) when the evidence establishes it; otherwise unknown.
projects.csv.development_type_unknown_reason: Why the development type is unknown.
projects.csv.operating_model: Operating model, for example colocation, when bound to evidence; otherwise unknown. Never inferred from the operator's other facilities.
projects.csv.operating_model_unknown_reason: Why the operating model is unknown. Empty when operating_model is known.
projects.csv.operating_model_evidence_id: evidence_id (evidence.csv) supporting the operating model. Empty when it is unknown.
projects.csv.workloads_json: JSON array of evidence-linked workload classifications, each with workload, deployment_scope (intended, operational or unknown), method, confidence (0 to 1), as_of_date and evidence_id. These are source classifications, not proof of an operating workload.
projects.csv.workload_unknown_reason: Why no workload classification is published. Empty when workloads_json lists one.
projects.csv.role_claims_json: JSON array of evidence-linked party role claims, each with role (operator, owner, customer, tenant or user), party, relationship_scope (current, intended or unknown) and evidence_id.
projects.csv.power_observations_json: JSON array of typed power observations, each with metric (critical_it_mw, gross_facility_mw, grid_connection_mw or generation_nameplate_mw), stage (for example planned, design or contracted), low, base and high values, unit (MW), method, confidence, as_of_date, target_date, evidence_id and notes. A planned or design value is not installed or operating capacity.
projects.csv.power_unknown_reason: Why no typed power observation is published. Missing power is unknown, never zero.
projects.csv.annual_energy_observations_json: JSON array of typed annual energy observations (metric annual_energy_mwh, unit MWh/year) with the same structure as power observations. Published only from scoped observations; never estimated from capacity.
projects.csv.annual_energy_unknown_reason: Why no annual energy observation is published.
projects.csv.efficiency_observations_json: JSON array of typed efficiency observations (metric pue, unit ratio) with the same structure as power observations. A design PUE is not measured performance.
projects.csv.efficiency_unknown_reason: Why no efficiency observation is published.
projects.csv.owner: Owner name(s) from evidence-linked owner role claims, separated by '; '. Empty when no owner claim is published.
projects.csv.operator: Operator name(s) from evidence-linked operator role claims (see role_claims_json), separated by '; '. Empty when no operator claim is published.
projects.csv.users: User name(s) from evidence-linked user role claims, separated by '; '. Empty when no user claim is published.
projects.csv.tenants: Tenant name(s) from evidence-linked tenant role claims, separated by '; '. Empty when no tenant claim is published.
projects.csv.customers: Customer name(s) from evidence-linked customer role claims, separated by '; '. Empty when no customer claim is published.
projects.csv.status_source_url: URL of the status source; the same as the source_url of the status evidence row.
projects.csv.geometry_source_url: URL of the primary geometry source; the same as the source_url of the geometry evidence row.

evidence.csv.evidence_id: Atlas identifier (UUID) of the evidence record. Primary key; referenced by status_evidence_id, geometry_evidence_id and the evidence_id of typed observations and role claims in projects.csv.
evidence.csv.roles_json: JSON array of how the evidence is used for the linked projects: physical_status, geometry, operating_model, workload, workload_scope:<scope>, role:<role>, typed_metric:<metric>, or context:<kind> for identity and distinctness context that creates no claim on its own.
evidence.csv.project_ids_json: JSON array of the project_id values (projects.csv) the evidence supports.
evidence.csv.kind: Kind of evidence, for example company_disclosure, government_record or openstreetmap.
evidence.csv.title: Title of the source document, page or record as captured.
evidence.csv.source_url: URL of the source. The Atlas links to sources; it does not redistribute third-party documents.
evidence.csv.publisher: Publisher or author of the source.
evidence.csv.source_family: Atlas grouping code for sources from the same publisher channel or API. Free-form code.
evidence.csv.license: Rights or licence code recorded for the source, for example CC-BY-4.0, ODbL-1.0 or all-rights-reserved. The source's own terms remain controlling.
evidence.csv.attribution: Attribution text required or recommended for the source.
evidence.csv.published_at: Publication date or timestamp of the source (ISO 8601) when the source states one; empty when it does not.
evidence.csv.retrieved_at: Date and time (ISO 8601) at which the source was retrieved or captured.
evidence.csv.content_hash: SHA-256 of the captured source content or compact capture, binding the evidence to exactly what was reviewed.

sites.official_boundary: true when at least one project at the site uses an official boundary geometry (geometry_use_scope = official_boundary).
sites.country_slug: Lower-case ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, used in country page URLs.
sites.url: Absolute URL of the site's HTML page.
sites.api_url: Absolute URL of the site's JSON document (api/v1/sites/<site_id>.json).

projects.evidence_ids: Sorted evidence_id values of every evidence row whose project_ids include the project.
projects.status_source: Object describing the status evidence: evidence_id, title, publisher, kind, published_at, source_url and license.
projects.url: Absolute URL of the project's section on its site page.
projects.api_url: Absolute URL of the project's JSON document (api/v1/projects/<project_id>.json).

evidence.site_ids: Sorted site_id values of the sites reached through project_ids.
evidence.url: Absolute URL of the evidence JSON document (api/v1/evidence/<evidence_id>.json).

site_summary.name: Site or campus name.
site_summary.latitude: Display anchor latitude (WGS 84). Not a footprint centroid.
site_summary.official_boundary: true when any project at the site uses an official boundary geometry.
site_summary.locator_scopes: Geometry use scopes of the site (sites.csv geometry_use_scopes_json).
site_summary.statuses: Distinct last observed physical statuses of the site's projects.
site_summary.newest_status_as_of: Latest project status date at the site.
site_summary.oldest_status_as_of: Earliest project status date at the site.
site_summary.projects: Linked projects as {project_id, name, status, status_as_of}, sorted by name.
site_summary.status_publishers: Sorted distinct publishers of the projects' status evidence.
site_summary.power_observations: Typed power observations of the site's projects as {project_id, metric, stage, low, base, high, unit, as_of_date}, ordered by project name then metric. Planned or design values are not installed capacity.
site_summary.independent_imagery_verification: Whether imagery verification is claimed; false throughout.
site_summary.url: Absolute URL of the site page.
site_summary.api_url: Absolute URL of the full site document.
